paid_plans: $2/month donation raises limit to 20,000 calls/month (docs); Apiable billing also lists paid tiers (e.g. ~$3/mo for 20k, higher for 60k)
rate_limits: 10,000 calls/month free; 20,000 calls/month with the ~$2–3/month supporter option; monthly quota in Ratelimit-* response headers; per-key throttle ~1–4 req/s by plan
resolution_notes: pricing/rate_limits: AUDITOR RIGHT. Free quota is 10,000/month, not 20,000. Official site shows “10,000 Free calls each month” (https://pirateweather.net/); docs: “$2 monthly donation… raise your API limit from 10,000… to 20,000” (https://docs.pirateweather.net/en/latest/); Apiable plans: free ≤10,000; paid raises to 20,000+ (https://pirate-weather.apiable.io/products/weatherdata/plans). Ratelimit-* headers document monthly quota (https://docs.pirateweather.net/en/latest/API/). Changelog “raised free tier to 20,000” is historical, overridden by current site/docs/billing.
